scoring_semantics.mandatory_violation: FAIL only if applicable, directly evidenced, attributable, pinned version and authorized
scoring_semantics.not_applicable: predicate false with evidence; never treat unknown as N/A
scoring_semantics.recommendation: may produce non-scored improvement only; never FAIL
scoring_semantics.unknown: insufficient scope or observation; no implied PASS
scoring_semantics.original_maturity: unaffected; no new product levels authorized
scoring_semantics.hypotheses: Uncalibrated numeric thresholds and heuristics are research-only; never count as protocol violation or product FAIL
scoring_semantics.equivalent_implementations: Accept any demonstrated mechanism meeting the observable safety/recovery outcome, not one preferred field or serialization

evidence_catalog.description: Normative scope, indirect empirical context and hypotheses are not interchangeable; no source proves an entire ARE quality check

MCP_TOOLS_2026.scope: Tool listing, result content and isError recommendations; does not mandate JSON error envelopes

MCP_PAGINATION_2026.scope: Protocol list methods when using pagination; does not mandate cursor on every business tool

MCP_TASKS.scope: Optional Task extension; not a mandatory interface for every async tool

ERROR_REPAIR_2026.scope: Limited-model simulated tool repair; text with actionable information may perform similarly to JSON

MCP_TOOL_SPACE.scope: MCP response size and tool feedback observational data; not a causal cursor benefit test

MCP_AGENTBENCH.scope: Real MCP task benchmarking motivation; no particular cursor/idempotency design proven

HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_DRAFT.scope: HTTP idempotency-key draft; illustrative design, NOT an MCP MUST or adopted RFC
